apikey.tooltip: Your QWeather API key. Create a project with Web API credentials at dev.qweather.com to get one

apihost.tooltip: Required. Your dedicated API Host from the QWeather console (Settings page), e.g. abc123xyz.def.qweatherapi.com. The legacy public api.qweather.com host is being phased out from 2026

location.tooltip: A city name (e.g. Beijing or 上海), a QWeather Location ID (e.g. 101010100) or coordinates as longitude,latitude (e.g. 116.41,39.92)

lang.tooltip: Language for weather texts returned by QWeather. 'Automatic' follows the system locale when supported; otherwise QWeather chooses the location's local language with its own fallback

tunits.tooltip: Measurement units used to display temperature

wunits.tooltip: Measurement units used to display wind speed

windscale.tooltip: Show the Beaufort wind force (e.g. Force 3) instead of the wind speed

punits.tooltip: Measurement units used to display atmospheric pressure

userno.tooltip: The number of days of forecast to display. Your QWeather subscription may support fewer days than requested

refreshtime.tooltip: Period between refreshing forecasts. QWeather data is updated every 10-20 minutes

display__cc__weather.tooltip: Check to display the current weather and large icon

display__cc__feelslike.tooltip: Check to display the current apparent temperature

display__cc__humidity.tooltip: Check to display the current humidity

display__cc__wind_speed.tooltip: Check to display the current wind

display__cc__pressure.tooltip: Check to display the current pressure

display__cc__aqi.tooltip: Check to display the current local air quality index, coloured by pollution level

display__cc__visibility.tooltip: Check to display the current visibility

display__cc__precip.tooltip: Check to display the current precipitation of the past hour

display__cc__uv.tooltip: Check to display the current ultraviolet index

display__cc__sun.tooltip: Check to display today's sunrise and sunset times

display__hourly.tooltip: Check to display the forecast for the next hours

display__warning.tooltip: Check to display severe weather warning banners for your location

display__forecast__maximum_temperature.tooltip: Check to display the forecast maximum temperature

display__forecast__minimum_temperature.tooltip: Check to display the forecast minimum temperature

display__forecast__wind_speed.tooltip: Check to display the forecast wind speed

display__forecast__wind_direction.tooltip: Check to display the forecast wind direction

display__forecast__uv.tooltip: Check to display the forecast maximum UV index

display__forecast__precip.tooltip: Check to display the forecast daytime precipitation amount

display__meta__region.tooltip: Check to display the region (province) after the city name

display__meta__country.tooltip: Check to display the country after the city name

zoom.tooltip: Change the size of the desklet

layout.tooltip: Set the overall layout of the desklet

iconstyle.tooltip: Select the style for the weather icons

citystyle.tooltip: Check to display the city name in bold

overrideTheme.description: Override desktop theme (enables the settings below)
overrideTheme.tooltip: Check this to override the desktop theme and configure the appearance manually

transparency.tooltip: Set the transparency of the desklet

textcolor.tooltip: Click the button to select a new text color

textshadow.tooltip: Check to add a text shadow

shadowblur.tooltip: Set the text shadow sharp (1) or blurry (2-7)

bgcolor.tooltip: Click the button to select a new background color

cornerradius.tooltip: Radius for rounding the desklet's corners

border.tooltip: Check this to turn border on/off

bordercolor.tooltip: Select the color for the border. Only available if the 'Border' checkbox is enabled

borderwidth.tooltip: Select the width of the border. Only available if the 'Border' checkbox is enabled

experimental_enabled.tooltip: Check this to enable experimental and buggy features

gravity.tooltip: Select the point on the desklet to which it is anchored. This point will remain static as the desklet grows and shrinks
